title: Lumora
description: A lightweight Fabric modpack focused on soft visuals, smooth performance, Mellow Shader, clean animations and a polished vanilla feel.
body:
## About

Lumora is a lightweight client-side Fabric modpack built for players who want Minecraft to look cleaner, softer and more polished without turning the game into a heavy overhaul.

It keeps the vanilla feel, but improves the parts you notice every time you play: smoother performance, better lighting, subtle particles, cleaner UI details, Fresh Animations support, a round minimap, improved resource pack ordering and Mellow Shader enabled by default.

The goal is simple: a good-looking Minecraft setup that is ready to play, easy to run and not filled with unnecessary mods.

## What Lumora changes

Lumora improves the game through performance mods, visual fixes, shader support, animation packs, resource packs and small quality-of-life tweaks.

It includes a tuned Sodium/Iris setup, Mellow Shader, optimized render settings around 12 chunks, lightweight visual effects, better entity rendering, dynamic lighting, smoother particles and a cleaner map/UI setup.

No gameplay overhaul. No bloated progression systems. No random content spam. Just a cleaner Minecraft experience.

## Main features

* Mellow Shader enabled by default
* Optimized performance-focused Fabric setup
* Render distance tuned around 12 chunks
* Fancy clouds and fancy leaves
* Fresh Animations support
* FA+ Player animation support
* Round minimap on the left side
* Clean resource pack stack
* Subtle visual effects and particles
* Better memory and rendering optimizations
* Client-side focused setup
* Ready to play after import

## Performance focus

Lumora is designed to look good while staying practical. It uses performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, Entity Culling and other rendering optimizations to keep the game smoother than a normal visual-heavy setup.

The included settings are tuned to keep the pack light, stable and visually consistent.

## Shader

Lumora uses Mellow Shader as its default shaderpack. It gives the game a softer, painterly look without pushing the pack into ultra-heavy cinematic shader territory.

## Compatibility

This pack is built for Minecraft 26.1.2 with Fabric.

It is mainly client-side and does not require a server-side modpack for normal use. Some servers may still have their own rules about minimaps, shaders or client-side visual mods, so check server rules before joining.

## Notes

Lumora is not made to completely change Minecraft. It is made to make Minecraft feel cleaner, smoother and nicer to look at.

If you want a light visual setup with performance already tuned, this is the point of the pack.
